metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the sci-paper scientific writing + review + ideation plugin.

plugins.name: sci-paper
plugins.description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). Ships 8 skills and 22 tools under one typed scientific-writing standard: source-traced integrity blockers, zero-target L0, ranked advisories, explicit measurement states, a unified three-pass de-AI skill (subsystem measurement, two vendored humanizer audits, claim-first rewriting), a condense skill executing the hard length budget with one-canonical-home deduplication, A-R review with narrative-spine and adversarial-escalation dimensions, pixel-measured figure balance, and isolated multi-review orchestration. See CHANGELOG.md for per-version history.
